veranderings.voor: wat in Suid-Afrika beoefen word, daaroor leer
veranderings.rede: Two stacked 'wat' clauses make the sentence hard to follow for Grade 6; 'in Suid-Afrika' keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: sonder om hulle naam te noem
veranderings.na: sonder om hulle naam bekend te maak
veranderings.rede: 'Naam bekend maak' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for giving anonymously.

veranderings.voor: dus geld dit vir elke mens
veranderings.na: en daarom geld dit vir elke mens
veranderings.rede: 'Dus' after a comma reads stiffly here; 'en daarom' links the two clauses more naturally for Grade 6.
The name is the Hindus' own, not one 'we' give it; the passive states it without implying the lesson named it.

veranderings.voor: wat sê 'n mens is 'n mens deur ander mense
veranderings.na: wat sê dat 'n mens 'n mens is deur ander mense
veranderings.rede: Reported speech without a colon or quotation marks needs 'dat' and verb-final word order.

vlae.teks: 'n Man van 'n ander groep het stilgehou en hom versorg.
vlae.rede: 'Groep' is vague (the parable's point is a man of another people); sharpening it would mean choosing content, so it is flagged, not changed.
